dict.string: From munki PR #1305 / Munki 7.1 Assisted App Quit
Enables Managed Software Center assisted quit of blocking apps (Munki 7.1+). Sets MSCOfferToQuitBlockingApps, MSCOfferToForceQuitBlockingApps, and MSCOfferToUpdateOthers.

#!/bin/bash # Exit 0 = not installed (needs install); non-zero = already installed PREF_DOMAIN="/Library/Preferences/ManagedInstalls" quit=$(defaults read "$PREF_DOMAIN" MSCOfferToQuitBlockingApps 2>/dev/null || echo 0) force=$(defaults read "$PREF_DOMAIN" MSCOfferToForceQuitBlockingApps 2>/dev/null || echo 0) others=$(defaults read "$PREF_DOMAIN" MSCOfferToUpdateOthers 2>/dev/null || echo 0) if [[ "$quit" == "1" && "$force" == "1" && "$others" == "1" ]]; then exit 1 fi exit 0

#!/bin/bash # Enable Munki 7.1+ Assisted App Quit for Managed Software Center. # Docs: https://github.com/munki/munki/wiki/Munki-7.1-Assisted-App-Quit PREF_DOMAIN="/Library/Preferences/ManagedInstalls" defaults write "$PREF_DOMAIN" MSCOfferToQuitBlockingApps -bool true defaults write "$PREF_DOMAIN" MSCOfferToForceQuitBlockingApps -bool true defaults write "$PREF_DOMAIN" MSCOfferToUpdateOthers -bool true exit 0

#!/bin/bash PREF_DOMAIN="/Library/Preferences/ManagedInstalls" defaults delete "$PREF_DOMAIN" MSCOfferToQuitBlockingApps 2>/dev/null || true defaults delete "$PREF_DOMAIN" MSCOfferToForceQuitBlockingApps 2>/dev/null || true defaults delete "$PREF_DOMAIN" MSCOfferToUpdateOthers 2>/dev/null || true exit 0
